en-us.whatsNewHeroBody: Redesigned from top to bottom, with new ways to talk. Your chats, contacts and wallet are all still here.
en-us.whatsNewReplyBody: Swipe a message to reply, react with one tap, or fix a typo after you send. Works best with contacts on the new Spixi.
en-us.whatsNewVoiceBody: Record a message instead of typing it. Contacts on an older Spixi get it as an audio file.
en-us.whatsNewPhotosBody: Send up to 10 photos at once and open them full screen. Spixi removes the location from the photos you send.
en-us.whatsNewPrivacyBody: Hide read receipts, typing and your online status. You find all three in Settings › Privacy.
en-us.whatsNewAppsBody: Invite a contact to a game or a tool. They join with one tap, right in the chat.
en-us.bheroBody: Redesigned from top to bottom. Your chats, contacts and wallet are all still here.
en-us.breplyBody: Swipe to reply, hold to react, fix a typo after you send. Best with contacts on the new Spixi.
en-us.bvoiceBody: Tap the mic, talk, and send. Contacts on an older Spixi get an audio file.
en-us.bphotosBody: Send up to 10 photos as one album. Spixi removes their location first.
en-us.bprivacyBody: Hide read receipts, typing and your online status, in Settings › Privacy.
en-us.bappsBody: Invite a contact to a mini app. They join with one tap, right in the chat.
